program:
app "Mobile shop" phone plum
table accessory name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 10, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(accessory, it.qty <= it.low)
short "accessories running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each accessory where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(accessory, it.qty * it.price) faint
form accessory
remind "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Mobile shop, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- accessory: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 10; price: money, optional; kind: one of Home, Work, Other; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the accessory have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "accessories running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each accessory where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the accessory for editing; a swipe removes the accessory, with undo:
    - text: the name of the accessory.
    - text: the kind of the accessory.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the accessory.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the accessory.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the accessory.
- a form to add a accessory.
Reminder "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the screen layout first if there is one

program:
app "Pet costs" paw ocean
table pet_cost what text, amount money, note text?
state m date = today
let spent = sum(pet_cost.amount month of m)
setting budget money = 10000 "Monthly budget"
screen main "Spend" wallet
  monthnav m
  if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
  goal spent, budget, "spent"
  "Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
  form pet_cost
screen charts "Charts" chart
  list pet_cost month of m by day
describe:
Pet costs, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- pet cost: what: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 10000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of pet cost in the month of m.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- a screen "Spend":
  - arrows that move m back and forward one month.
  - text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
  - spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
  - text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
  - a form to add a pet cost.
- a screen "Charts":
  - a list of pet cost in the month of m by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Badminton" ball slate
table point team pick Ali|Sara, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Ali)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Sara)
setting winat num = 21 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Ali" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Ali, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Ali, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Sara" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Sara, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Sara, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Ali win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Sara win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Badminton, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Ali, Sara; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 21.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Ali.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Sara.
Shows:
- text: "Ali".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Ali, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Ali, pts set to 2.
- text: "Sara".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Sara, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Sara, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Ali win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Sara win!".
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

describe:

- text: how many piano done entries today, "today".
- how many piano done entries today out of target with a progress bar, labelled "today".
- a countdown timer of 5 minutes, labelled "Rest"; when it ends it shows the notice "Time is up".
- a list of piano done today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time for piano practice" at 22:00 every day.
